what_this_is: Each published version (a Marketplace configuration row) may carry a `disposition` that moderation gave that exact version, and an install records it. install_policy says which dispositions an install refuses; it is DATA and, shipped, refuses only a version that was blocked, so every other install goes ahead and is simply labelled. A row with no disposition (every row published before this) is recorded as `unrated`. A person, space or deployment can pass its own policy (installedConfiguration's `policy`) to refuse more, such as review-required.

words.refused: {title} {version} was blocked, so it cannot be installed. Its disposition is {disposition}.
words.refused_by_policy: {title} {version} is marked {disposition}, which this install policy refuses.
